scripts.dev: pnpm run clean && node scripts/generate-docs-artifacts.js && node scripts/generate-api-verification-report.js && node scripts/generate-search-index.js && pnpm exec next dev --port 3001
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && node scripts/generate-docs-artifacts.js && node scripts/generate-api-verification-report.js && node scripts/validate-docs.js && node scripts/generate-search-index.js && pnpm exec eslint . --ext .js,.jsx,.ts,.tsx && pnpm exec next build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec next typegen && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
